outcome: Isolation of decidual natural killer (dNK) cells
cohort: The study samples were derived from placentas of healthy women undergoing scheduled elective cesarean delivery and complete hydatidiform moles from individuals after evacuation and curettage.
finding: A novel protocol was developed that successfully produces high quantities of enriched dNK cells which can be sustained in cell culture for at least a month, preserving their phenotype and functionality for a week.
